title: MASTER REDEEMER SAVIOUR OF THE WORLD

lines.text: Master, Redeemer, Saviour of the world
Lily of the valley, Provider and Friend,
He was yesterday, He'll be tomorrow
But the angel called Him Jesus,
Jehovah, Messiah, Mighty God and King,
Breath of life, lasting Word of love that I sing.
Light in darkness, Door to Heaven

lyrics:
[Verse]
Master, Redeemer, Saviour of the world
Wonderful, Counsellor
Bright morning star,
Lily of the valley, Provider and Friend,
He was yesterday, He'll be tomorrow
The Beginning and End.

[Verse]
But the angel called Him Jesus,
Born of a virgin, .
Mary called Him Jesus,
But I call Him Lord.

[Verse]
Jehovah, Messiah, Mighty God and King,
Breath of life, lasting Word of love that I sing.
Light in darkness, Door to Heaven
My home in the sky,
The fountain of living water,
That never shall run dry.
